results.title: Why Active Directory Auditing Should Be Part of Every Security Strategy
results.description: Someone was added to Domain Admins. You notice it three weeks later. At that point, knowing who is a Domain Admin today is not enough. The real questions are: who added that user, when did it happen, and was the change intentional? That is the core value of Active Directory auditing.
